Yuxi Global / Strategy & brand experience

A value proposition people can understand.

A digital-presence transformation connecting services, brand and talent.

UX/UI & Digital StrategyJuan Carvajal
THE STARTING POINT

Yuxi Global

A technology-services business operating in the United States and Colombia needed to communicate clearly what it did and whom it helped.

PROJECT CONTEXT
01 / The challenge02 / The solution03 / Decisions04 / The impact
01

The challenge

Experiences varied between channels and the business proposition was unclear, even to people within the organization.

02

The solution

The new direction started with three questions: what we do, how we want to be seen and how to attract talent. The architecture centered on Services, Careers and Media.

03

Decisions that make the difference

01

Define a shared concept before redesigning the channels.

02

Distinguish client and candidate needs in navigation.

03

Connect content with digital-presence goals.

04 / The impact

Services, talent and brand connected

A digital ecosystem with a brand narrative and content structure aligned with clients and future team members. The original case publishes no conversion metrics.
